summary: Planned paved waterfront plaza between Piers 48 and 50. The Design Controls say it 'will continue to serve as a functioning wharf while providing public access'. The Port's June 2026 resolution lists the marginal wharf between Pier 48 and Pier 50 as part of the project site.

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) defines Channel Wharf as a dedicated open space (Section 3.5)

facts.value: Envisioned as a paved open space (a 'wharf landscape') with public access, art and seating; the controls suggest a large-scale industrial object or other feature as a destination

sources.title: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (final; Section 3 open spaces, Figure 3.1.1)

Informational presentation on updates to the Mission Rock Development Project, including efforts to accelerate Phase 2, with possible action on a Port Capital investment of $10 million (Port Commission Item 11A, Resolution 26-34)

open_questions: No source read reports the plaza as built; current condition not confirmed.
Which phase delivers it is not stated in any source read.
